title: The Lost Caverns of Ixalan | Episode 4

entities.name: Quintorius Kand
entities.description: A loxodon archaeologist and planeswalker who summons Abuelo's Echo and helps open the golden door.

entities.name: Wayta
entities.description: A Sun Empire warrior with one visible eye, who fought at Tocatli, served with the Brazen Coalition, and writes poetry.

entities.name: Huatli
entities.description: The Sun Empire's warrior-poet and a planeswalker, who negotiates with the River Heralds and solves the cosmium key.

entities.name: Inti
entities.description: A Sun Empire officer who wants the vampires imprisoned and urges a strike against Torrezon.

entities.name: Caparocti
entities.description: A Sun Empire officer who wants the vampires killed and argues the time is right to strike Torrezon.

entities.name: Pantlaza
entities.description: Huatli's big raptor-like dinosaur.

entities.name: Abuelo
entities.description: The Echo of an Oltec man bound to a poncho, who remembers Matzalantli and the Mycotyrant and helps open the door.

entities.name: Abuela
entities.description: Abuelo's wife, who could make anything grow and whose khipu holds the key to the door.

entities.name: Nicanzil
entities.description: A young River Herald who guides the Sun Empire group to the convocation.

entities.name: Pashona
entities.description: A wizened merfolk shaper of the River Heralds who interrogates the newcomers and brokers cooperation.

entities.name: Malcolm
entities.description: A siren and Brazen Coalition emissary who descends to the fungal forest and confronts the Mycotyrant.

entities.name: Breeches
entities.description: A goblin pirate who accompanies Malcolm.

entities.name: Xavier Sal
entities.description: The mayor of Downtown, now infected and speaking for the Mycotyrant.

entities.name: Mycotyrant
entities.description: A giant toadlike fungal entity hanging in a web of rootlike strands, whose colony absorbs the people it infects and which wants the sun.

entities.name: Amalia Benavides Aguirre
entities.description: A vampire cartographer who sees her visions come true in the Core and rewrites her map to help them flee.

entities.name: Kellan
entities.description: A young man with golden-light twig-hilted swords who is searching for the father he has never met.

entities.name: Bartolomé del Presidio
entities.description: A vampire who speaks for the Legion, confides doubts about the church, and is killed by Vito.

entities.name: Vito Quijano de Pasamonte
entities.description: The fanatical vampire leader of the Legion who demands a sacrifice to Aclazotz.

entities.name: Clavileño
entities.description: Vito's soldier who breaks down the door for him.

entities.name: Anim Pakal
entities.description: An Oltec commander of the Thousand Moons garrison at Matzalantli, who arrives on a bat and imprisons the vampires.

entities.name: Akal Pakal
entities.description: Anim's older sister and the Oltec steward who receives the Sun Empire delegation.

entities.name: Queen Miralda
entities.description: The queen of Torrezon, whom Bartolomé serves.

entities.name: Venerable Tarrian
entities.description: The figure whose words Vito says guided him.

entities.name: Aclazotz
entities.description: The vampire god whom Vito worships, called the Great Betrayer by the Oltec.

entities.name: Vona de Iedo
entities.description: A heretic whose whispers Amalia has heard.

entities.name: Chimil
entities.description: A god whose light the Mycotyrant has been denied.

entities.name: Matzalantli
entities.description: The sealed golden door and garrison at the entrance to the Core.

entities.name: The Core
entities.description: A hollow world inside Ixalan with an inverted landscape, a strange sun and the Oltec.

entities.name: Topizielo
entities.description: The region the Komon left the Core to explore.

entities.name: Oteclan
entities.description: An Oltec place to which word of the visitors is sent.

entities.name: Downtown
entities.description: The mining camp whose residents were absorbed by the Mycotyrant.

entities.name: Sunray Bay
entities.description: A Brazen Coalition town the Mycotyrant could consume.

entities.name: Ixalan
entities.description: The plane in which the story is set.

entities.name: Orazca
entities.description: The golden city taken from the River Heralds.

entities.name: Torrezon
entities.description: The vampire homeland, weakened by invasion and infighting.

entities.name: Sun Empire
entities.description: Huatli's empire, whose emperor wants a war against the vampires.

entities.name: River Heralds
entities.description: Merfolk who hold a convocation at the golden door.

entities.name: Dusk Legion
entities.description: The vampire expedition from Torrezon.

entities.name: Oltec
entities.description: The people of the Core who sealed the door and fear the Mycotyrant.

entities.name: Thousand Moons
entities.description: The Oltec garrison that guards the door at Matzalantli.

entities.name: Komon
entities.description: Oltec ancestors who left the Core and are presumed ancestors of the Sun Empire.

entities.name: Brazen Coalition
entities.description: A pirate alliance with a mining city below the surface.

entities.name: Queen's Bay Company
entities.description: The company Bartolomé claims to represent.

entities.name: Phyrexians
entities.description: Invaders from another plane who attacked Ixalan.

entities.name: Coin Empire
entities.description: A lost civilization Quint hopes to find evidence of.

entities.name: Malamet
entities.description: Catfolk who threw the Legion into the sand.

entities.name: Immortal Sun
entities.description: An artifact that Inti says a River Herald first claimed.

entities.name: Khipu
entities.description: A belt-like cord of knotted string and beads that holds the key to the golden door.

entities.name: Cosmium
entities.description: A pink mineral whose magic can affect Echoes and forms the key pattern for the door.

entities.name: Echo
entities.description: A spirit bound to an object, as Abuelo is bound to his poncho.

events.summary: Nicanzil summons the Sun Empire group to the convocation.
events.quote: The convocation begins

events.summary: The Sun Empire party reaches the top of the building facing the golden door and meets the vampires, provoking hostility.
events.quote: The other warriors mirrored her disgust, some reaching for weapons.

events.summary: Pashona questions Quint and Huatli about their intentions.
events.quote: Who are you, stranger?

events.summary: Inti and Caparocti call for the vampires to be imprisoned or killed, and Pashona threatens to return them to the sea.
events.quote: These invaders should be imprisoned

events.summary: Bartolomé warns that Torrezon and Queen Miralda would be displeased if the Legion is harmed.
events.quote: Torrezon as well. Queen Miralda would be most displeased.

events.summary: Huatli proposes that the Sun Empire and River Heralds cooperate to open the door.
events.quote: Shaper, your people and mine seek to open this door. I propose we work together.

events.summary: Huatli appeals to shared struggle against the Phyrexians to ease tensions over Orazca and the Immortal Sun.
events.quote: We all fought against the Phyrexians to defend our homes.

events.summary: Bartolomé says Queen Miralda might negotiate, and Vito silences him until Pashona allows the work to proceed.
events.quote: Queen Miralda might be open to such negotiations, depending on what we find.

events.summary: Quint summons Abuelo's Echo using the poncho.
events.quote: He pulled the poncho from his pack and once again cast the spell to summon Abuelo.

events.summary: Abuelo recognizes Matzalantli and says they must warn the Oltec about the Mycotyrant.
events.quote: We must get inside and warn the Oltec about the Mycotyrant.

events.summary: Abuelo uses Abuela's khipu to find the key to the golden door.
events.quote: Here! The golden door.

events.summary: Huatli recognizes the pattern as a key, arranges the cosmium beads, and the door unseals and swings open.
events.quote: Light burst through a crack at the seam of the now unsealed portal, which swung open with a rush of surprisingly cold, fresh air.

events.summary: Beyond the door, the party reaches a well-like opening showing a circle of sky deep underground.
events.quote: They stood before a circle of sky dotted with clouds.

events.summary: Figures above the well notice that the seal has been opened and call for Anim Pakal.
events.quote: Someone has opened the seal.

events.summary: Malcolm and Breeches fly and climb down the cenote and find the damaged elevator.
events.quote: They eventually found the elevator, damaged but mostly intact

events.summary: A glowing tunnel seems to guide or herd them onward.
events.quote: A tunnel to the left lit up while the glow around them faded, as if they were being guided.

events.summary: Malcolm and Breeches enter a vast fungal forest full of ruins.
events.quote: A fungal forest spread out before them, hauntingly beautiful, littered with crumbling ruins.

events.summary: Downtown's infected residents emerge, led by mayor Xavier Sal with button mushrooms for eyes.
events.quote: One of the humans stepped forward, his movements stilted, eyes replaced by glowing button mushrooms.

events.summary: Xavier announces that they are the Mycotyrant, and the giant fungal creature is revealed.
events.quote: We are the Mycotyrant.

events.summary: Xavier says Malcolm's companions and Downtown's residents have been incorporated into the colony.
events.quote: They have been incorporated into our colony, as have the ones who once resided in the place you call Downtown.

events.summary: When Malcolm asks what it wants, the Mycotyrant laughs with spores and answers 'Everything.'
events.quote: The Mycotyrant emitted a cloud of spores like a silent laugh.

events.summary: Amalia and Kellan step through the golden door into the Core, a hollow world matching her visions.
events.quote: A sprawling panorama spread before, above, and around her as she stepped through the portal.

events.summary: Amalia sees the central sun ringed by metal shards, as in her vision.
events.quote: At the center of it all, a strange sun hovered

events.summary: Anim Pakal arrives on a bat and demands to know how the seal was opened.
events.quote: I am called Anim Pakal

events.summary: Abuelo explains the plan to isolate and defeat the Mycotyrant has failed.
events.quote: The plan to isolate and defeat it has failed.

events.summary: Anim accuses the visitors of bringing ruin by opening the door.
events.quote: You have brought ruin to us.

events.summary: Anim explains that the Komon were Oltec ancestors who left the Core to explore Topizielo.
events.quote: The Komon are our ancestors who left the Core to explore Topizielo.

events.summary: When a soldier announces the Legion are vampires, Anim orders them imprisoned as worshippers of the Great Betrayer.
events.quote: Worshippers of the Great Betrayer are not welcome here

events.summary: Vito goes into a trance and says all proceeds according to Aclazotz's will.
events.quote: All proceeds according to his will

events.summary: Akal Pakal receives the Sun Empire group and raises the presence of vampires.
events.quote: I have heard some of your story from my sister Anim

events.summary: Inti and Caparocti urge the Oltec to help strike Torrezon while Huatli argues for peace.
events.quote: Now is the perfect time to strike.

events.summary: Abuelo tells Quint the khipu was Abuela's and Quint proposes bringing her back as an Echo.
events.quote: Perhaps we can bring her back, as I helped you come back.

events.summary: The Mycotyrant explains that its colony found the miners and wanted to know more of them.
events.quote: You dug through stone and ore and veins of shining crystal until one of your kind found us.

events.summary: Xavier says the Mycotyrant does not kill but changes and spreads.
events.quote: We do not kill. We change. We spread.

events.summary: The Mycotyrant reveals it wants the sun above and Malcolm realizes it could consume Sunray Bay and Ixalan.
events.quote: You have another sun above, and we will have it.

events.summary: The Legion is locked in empty detention rooms, weapons confiscated.
events.quote: Even so, the Legion vampires and their few remaining servants were locked up in empty rooms, weapons confiscated, and left to await their fates.

events.summary: Kellan questions the vampires, and Amalia defends the church's blood rites, then doubts.
events.quote: We only feed from criminals, evil people, and we use the power of blood to help others.

events.summary: Kellan reveals he is searching for the father he has never met.
events.quote: I'm searching for my father

events.summary: Vito conjures a thick magical fog over the building.
events.quote: A magical fog covered the building, so thick her hand would disappear if she thrust it through the opening.

events.summary: Amalia smells blood as the starving Legion soldiers feed on their own servants.
events.quote: When the scent of blood reached her, Amalia feared the worst.

events.summary: Bartolomé makes Amalia promise to return to Queen Miralda and tell her everything if he dies.
events.quote: if something happens to me, you must return to Queen Miralda. Tell her everything.

events.summary: Clavileño tears off the door and Vito enters, bloodstained.
events.quote: A crimson handprint was smeared down the front of his armor

events.summary: Vito demands Kellan's blood as a sacrifice to Aclazotz.
events.quote: The blood of the outsider will suffice

events.summary: Bartolomé attacks Vito to block the doorway while Kellan summons his swords.
events.quote: Bartolomé leaped at Vito, hands curled into claws, fangs bared.

events.summary: Vito breaks Bartolomé's neck and kills him.
events.quote: Vito locked an arm around Bartolomé's head and twisted, the terrible snap echoing in the small room.

events.summary: Amalia erases the wall from her map; mist rolls in and she and Kellan flee.
events.quote: The wall behind her vanished.

relations.quote: Vito locked an arm around Bartolomé's head and twisted, the terrible snap echoing in the small room.
I have heard some of your story from my sister Anim

relations.note: imprisons them as worshippers of the Great Betrayer
relations.quote: Worshippers of the Great Betrayer are not welcome here

relations.note: his wife, keeper of the khipu
relations.quote: Abuela kept it in her khipu, and I always stayed with her
Xavier's mouth stretched in a rictus that mirrored his puppet-master's motion.

relations.note: their plan to isolate and defeat it failed
relations.quote: The plan to isolate and defeat it has failed.

relations.note: steps aside to let Vito enter
relations.quote: Clavileño glared at Bartolomé, then stepped aside to allow Vito entry.

relations.note: tells Amalia to report to her
relations.quote: you must return to Queen Miralda
Amalia positioned herself in front of Kel, who protested and moved to her side.

relations.note: comforts him and tries to protect him
relations.quote: laying a hand on Kellan's shoulder

relations.note: warred with the vampires before the Phyrexian invasion
Oltec ancestors who left the Core
relations.quote: The Komon are our ancestors who left the Core to explore Topizielo.
